evidence: L-01 gate waiver — AUTH_MODE=token single-user posture (boss decision, 2026-09-12)

whatL01Requires.predicate: authConfigPass = (AUTH_MODE === 'required') && storageProvider === 'postgres' && Boolean(SUPABASE_URL), AND strict TLS configured, AND database TLS active, AND the context-spoofing negative test passes
whatL01Requires.intent: the service is only reachable by an authenticated identity, over verified TLS, and a forged service-context request is rejected

currentPosture.COCHPIA_API_TOKEN: present (64 hex chars), set in .env on 2026-09-12
currentPosture.strictTls: now detected as configured after the 2026-09-12 db-ssl fix (sslmode=verify-full in DATABASE_URL)

exactGap: Exactly one predicate fails: authRequired && supabaseConfigured. Supabase multi-user auth is not deployed, so L-01 can only report pending in machine output. Every other part of L-01's intent is either satisfied or has an equivalent control.
whyWaived: Boss decision (2026-09-11, evidence/auth-token-2026-09-11.json): this is a single-user personal instance. Supabase would add an external identity dependency serving no second user.

The security intent is covered by equivalent controls: every off-box request must present the shared token (sha256 + timingSafeEqual compare, captured in server/auth.js and the TLS edge); the loopback surface is trusted as the owner's own machine.

The credential path was exercised for real across two machines over TLS on 2026-09-11: 14/14 acceptance twice, including the negative case where an off-box request without a bearer token is rejected 401 AUTH_REQUIRED.
residualRisk: Token mode is a single shared credential: no per-user identity, no per-user revocation and no per-user audit trail.
If the token leaks, off-box access is complete until rotation.
The loopback surface remains unauthenticated by design — any local process runs as the owner.
reviewTriggers: A second real user appears -> switch to AUTH_MODE=required with Supabase, L-01 becomes achievable as written.
The service is ever exposed beyond the owner's own machine/trusted LAN -> re-evaluate before, not after.
Any need for per-user revocation or an access audit trail.
boundary: This waiver does NOT mark L-01 as passed. Machine output keeps reporting L-01 as pending; this file is a human decision recorded next to it, and any promotion statement citing the gate must cite this waiver explicitly rather than claiming a green L-01.

recognition.howRecorded: The waiver was presented with its scope, substitute controls, residual risk and review triggers; the owner answered "可以" in the same session. Recorded here so the decision is auditable rather than living in chat history.
recognition.effect: Promotion may state the gate as 'L-02 passed + L-01 waived'. It may not state 'L-01 passed'. If any review trigger fires, this waiver is void and AUTH_MODE=required + Supabase must be deployed before L-01 can be cited at all.
